description: Statically analyze a regex pattern for catastrophic-backtracking (ReDoS) risk. Flags nested unbounded quantifiers ((a+)+), overlapping alternation under a repeat ((a|ab)*), and adjacent overlapping quantifiers (\d+\d+). Heuristic linter, not a formal proof. Pass the pattern body only, no delimiters or flags.

pattern.description: The regex pattern body to analyze, e.g. (a+)+

name: detect_redos
